svg.title: Components inside the review module
svg.desc: The review module sits at the top of the dependency order. It reads the api of budget, procurement, finance and projects, keeps projections in its own schema, and calls platform for rights, audit, tasks and AI. No module depends on review. The agent runtime lives in platform, and review governs it.
